description.value:
You use the Force to lift an unattended light- or vibro-weapon within range, animating it to fight at your direction until you dismiss the power or cast it again. As part of casting, and again as a bonus action on later turns, you can send the weapon up to 20 feet through the air and have it make a melee force attack against a creature within 5 feet of it, dealing 1d8 plus your forcecasting ability modifier damage of the weapon's normal type on a hit. You may recall the weapon to your hand at any time while the power lasts.

A creature can try to seize the floating weapon by using its action to beat your force save DC with a Strength (Athletics) check; success ends the power and gives the creature the weapon.

Cast with a slot of 3rd level or higher, the weapon's damage increases by 1d8 for every two slot levels beyond 2nd.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Universal Powers, Level 2
